_comment: 'reproducible' is the sha256 produced by contracts/scripts/build-reproducible.sh with the
CORRECTION 2026-10-21 — READ BEFORE TRUSTING THE LINE BELOW: this file used to say that CI
rebuilds and compares, implying the comparison passes. CI does rebuild and compare, and it
HAS FAILED on every run since 2026-09-08 (runs 34285692880, 34286312201, 39188099409), with a
different hash for all three contracts. So the build is reproducible ON THE SAME MACHINE --
proven: the local optimized build equals the on-chain binary, 64cb01f427a4e72c... -- but it is
NOT reproducible BETWEEN machines. Pinning rustc in rust-toolchain.toml was not enough. Until
that is fixed, a third party CANNOT independently reproduce these hashes, and M-05 is not
closed under the criterion that matters, which is exactly 'anyone can rebuild and compare'.
'deployed' is the sha256 fetched from the ledger with `stellar contract fetch`.
READ THIS: the deployed binaries were built BEFORE the toolchain was pinned and before path
remapping existed, so they do NOT match the reproducible hashes and cannot be reproduced from
this tree. That is the honest state of M-05 today, not a defect introduced here. The next
controller deployment is built with this script and its hash is recorded as matching.

margin-controller.note: First deployment built with contracts/scripts/build-reproducible.sh. The ledger hash equals the optimized reproducible hash WHEN REBUILT ON THE MACHINE THAT PRODUCED IT (verified 2026-10-21: the deployed binary is 64cb01f427a4e72c...). It does NOT reproduce in CI -- see the CORRECTION in _comment. The earlier wording here, 'anyone can rebuild and compare', overstated it and is withdrawn. Closes M-03, M-04 and M-02.

oracle-aggregator.note: Sits in the pool's immutable oracle slot: it cannot be replaced without a new pool. The mismatch is permanent for this deployment and is disclosed, not fixed.

margin-controller-v-previous.note: Superseded 2026-09-02. Built before the toolchain pin, so not reproducible. Kept live: published evidence links to it, and 10 XLM remain locked in it (see audit/12_FINDINGS_CLOSED.md, finding N-01).
